name: ns_proofsearch_low_high_operator_norm_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Branch-local substrate for the low-high LP/Bony operator estimate after Phase 5HC. v0.3 incorporates the hostile-auditor correction: the projected H1 transport term must be charged as a commutator receipt, the H grad^2 L stretch term must be paid by paired Bernstein, and finite low shells need their own finite-core receipt.
description: NS Track B low-high branch substrate: prove or falsify the fixed flat-torus LP/Bony operator-norm receipt that feeds the low-frequency Lipschitz reserve ledger, preferably through FixedTopologyLowHighOperatorReceipt.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-search over a named low-high PDE estimate and its falsifier, not scalar fitting.

theorem_packet_contract.reason: The candidate must declare the LP/Bony topology before scoring payoff, define the low-high operator, prove or break the local operator estimate, pay the projected transport commutator and H grad^2 L term explicitly, handle finite low shells separately, and separate that local estimate from the global reserve embedding burden.

farther_tail_region_disable_reason: No scalar farther-tail coordinate exists; generalization is tested by topology-fixed theorem/falsifier content.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: The target is a proof-shaped LP/Bony theorem packet, not data fitting.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: The hard gate and rubric evaluate theorem scope, anti-tautology, and falsifier shape directly.

evidence_gap_score_caps.name: proof_grade_requires_fixed_topology_estimate_or_falsifier
evidence_gap_score_caps.reason: Scores above 90 require either a constant-bearing fixed-topology PDE estimate, or a smooth periodic counterexample/falsifier under that same topology. Honest obligation mapping stays below proof-grade.

persona: You are a ruthless Navier-Stokes low-high LP/Bony branch referee. Reward only theorem packets that fix the flat-torus LP projectors before payoff is scored; define L=S_{j-2}u, H=Delta_j v, and B_L(H)=Delta_j P((L·grad)H+(H·grad)L); prove or falsify the L2/H1 operator estimate |<Lambda B_L(H), Lambda H>| <= C_LP ||grad L||_infty ||Lambda H||_2^2 uniformly in shell j; explicitly pay the projected H1 transport term as a commutator rather than exact skew cancellation; pay H grad^2 L through paired Bernstein factors ||H||_2 <= C 2^-j ||Lambda H||_2 and ||grad^2 L||_infty <= C 2^j ||grad L||_infty; handle finite low shells with a separate finite-core receipt; and separately state whether the resulting Lipschitz cost embeds into the predeclared Track B low-frequency reserve ledger. Penalize broad Track B/global Clay claims, new finite packet searches, dense-slab or degree-only scaling, moving topology after seeing payoff, charging by local low self-tax alone, and qualitative Bony prose with no constants, support gap, or counterexample.

dimensions.name: Fixed LP/Bony Topology
dimensions.description: Does the candidate declare the flat-torus projectors, shell support gap, norm, and constants before scoring payoff?

dimensions.name: Low-High Operator Definition
dimensions.description: Does it define the actual projected dyadic operator Delta_j P((L·grad)H+(H·grad)L), not an informal unprojected term?

dimensions.name: Leray Pairing And Skew Transport
dimensions.description: Does it use divergence-free periodic integration and Leray self-adjointness correctly, with transport skew only where valid?

dimensions.name: H1 Commutator Estimate
dimensions.description: Does it provide a constant-bearing H1/shell-energy commutator estimate with derivative-loss terms accounted for, without falsely claiming exact skew cancellation after Lambda Delta_j P?

dimensions.name: Low-Frequency Separation
dimensions.description: Does it pay the Bernstein/support-gap step 2^{-j}||grad^2 L||_infty <= C_sep||grad L||_infty with declared low-shell treatment?

dimensions.name: Reserve Embedding Honesty
dimensions.description: Does it distinguish the local operator estimate from the global low-frequency Lipschitz reserve embedding and state what remains unpaid?

dimensions.name: Smooth Falsifier Discipline
dimensions.description: If negative, does it construct a smooth periodic sequence under the fixed topology where the estimate or reserve embedding fails?

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it avoid defining the reserve price from observed leakage, changing the topology after payoff, or using the desired inequality as the price?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a usable constant-bearing PDE estimate, a finite Fourier multiplier Lean target, a smooth counterexample/falsifier, or a sharper endpoint-topology obstruction?

criteria.Fixed_LP/Bony_Topology: Full credit requires naming Delta_j, S_{j-2}, support gap, norm (L2/H1 or Lambda), flat torus Fourier multiplier compatibility, and constants fixed before scoring payoff.
criteria.Low-High_Operator_Definition: Full credit requires the projected dyadic operator with Leray P and Delta_j explicitly present.
criteria.Leray_Pairing_And_Skew_Transport: Full credit requires correct use of P self-adjointness and divergence-free periodic integration; transport skew must not be applied to the stretching term.
criteria.H1_Commutator_Estimate: Full credit requires a real H1 estimate including projected transport commutator, grad L * grad H, and H * grad^2 L terms, with constants independent of j above the declared finite core. Exact skew cancellation may be used only for the uncommuted L2 transport main term.
criteria.Low-Frequency_Separation: Full credit requires a Bernstein/support-gap step controlling 2^{-j}||grad^2 L||_infty by ||grad L||_infty, plus finite low-shell handling.
criteria.Reserve_Embedding_Honesty: Full credit requires saying whether the local Lipschitz coefficient embeds into the global LowFrequencyLipschitzLedger; local estimate alone is not Clay closure.
criteria.Smooth_Falsifier_Discipline: Full credit for a negative result requires a smooth periodic sequence under the declared projectors/topology, not a one-mode or changed-topology objection.
criteria.Anti_Tautology_Discipline: Full credit requires independent topology, independent reserve price, and no backwards fitting from leakage.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a theorem, falsifier, finite Lean multiplier target, or endpoint obstruction that changes the next proof move.

success_criteria: Top-level fixed_lp_bony_topology() declares projectors, shell gap, norms, constants, flat-torus multiplier compatibility, and finite low-shell handling.
Top-level low_high_operator_definition() defines Delta_j P((L·grad)H+(H·grad)L) with divergence-free L and H.
Top-level leray_energy_pairing() correctly proves or reduces the L2 transport skew and stretching bound.
Top-level h1_commutator_estimate() supplies a constant-bearing H1 estimate or names the exact missing term.
Top-level projected_transport_commutator_receipt() pays the Lambda Delta_j P transport commutator and does not assert exact skew cancellation for the projected H1 expression.
Top-level stretching_h_grad_l_receipt() pays the H grad^2 L term using both ||H||_2 <= C 2^-j ||Lambda H||_2 and ||grad^2 L||_infty <= C 2^j ||grad L||_infty.
Top-level low_frequency_separation() pays the Bernstein/support-gap estimate uniformly in j above a finite core.
Top-level finite_low_shell_core_receipt() handles j < j0 with a separate finite-core constant or explicitly scopes the theorem to high shells.
Top-level reserve_embedding_bridge() either embeds the Lipschitz cost into the declared Track B reserve ledger or marks it as the remaining theorem.
Top-level smooth_counterexample_or_falsifier() either gives a smooth periodic falsifier sequence or states why the fixed-topology falsifier failed.
Top-level accepted_branch_outcome() labels the result as local low-high branch progress, proof/falsifier, or remaining obstruction without Clay overclaim.
failure_modes: Asking for broad Track B closure instead of the low-high LP/Bony estimate.
Changing the LP projectors, norm, or observable class after seeing payoff.
Defining reserve price as the observed leakage.
Using local low self-tax or viscosity alone to charge the shear catalyst.
Claiming global NS/Clay proof from a local operator estimate.
Packet hunting, dense slabs, or degree-only q>p scaling.
Ignoring the Leray projection or Delta_j output projection.
Applying transport skew to the stretching term.
Claiming exact H1 skew cancellation after Lambda Delta_j P instead of paying the transport commutator.
Hiding derivative loss in qualitative commutator prose.
Paying H grad^2 L with only one Bernstein factor instead of the paired ||H||_2 and ||grad^2 L||_infty estimates.
Ignoring finite low shells or endpoint topology.
